title: Opus 5.5 is a beast. Made a full game in less than a month...
author: MacXou34
selftext:
Never thought I would, one day, make a game so features packed in... Less than a month. Been coding for the past two decades, and with AI for the past year, well, I'll never write a single line of code again... 😱

Started working on Voltane, a RC car game around the 20 September, launched a beta about ten days ago and we are reaching a point where the game starts to be really complete and polished.

Just added local split screen, useable in the campaing mode, as well as the offline - and the online mode. 😍

What a time to be alive 😁

Feel free to check it out @ https://playvoltane.com

comments.author: MrLollypop2434
comments.body: This looks great! What did you use for creating car models? Because they look extremely well done and consistant.

replies.author: MacXou34
replies.body:
Thank you ! ☺️🤩

Tripo3d was used for the car models, but a lot of polish / optimisation was made by Opus, using Blender through MCP.. often, it had to fix the wheels and various details here and there 😁

replies.author: MrLollypop2434
replies.body:
That’s awesome! Could you go a little more in dept? What are the tools Claude used besides tripo and blender for modeling? Did you first do a lot of image generations or did Claude do these for you? Is game running in Godot or something else? How much total $$ did you spend to create this? (Excluding Claude) 

Sorry for bothering but I really wanna learn your workflow because this is 100% the best AI game I’ve seen here. Your site looks great btw. Animations as well! Speaking of animations, how did you design your web? Like bro… I’m so freaking AMAZED with everything that I can’t help but wonder what was your process like 🤯
